alerts.current_condition_details: Subject T-31 (Baghira) detected 280m from Khawasa village boundary wall during nocturnal hours (02:14 IST). High risk of livestock depredation or human-wildlife conflict.
alerts.assessment_notes: Ranger Quick Response Team 4 notified. Thermal drone surveillance deployed along Khawasa buffer sector B.

alerts.current_condition_details: Subject T-18 (Jamtara Phantom) expanded home range centroid by 4.2 km North into Chhatarpur agricultural buffer zone. Inter-male boundary contest suspected with T-09.
alerts.assessment_notes: Camera density increased in Chhatarpur north quadrant to monitor scent marking trees.

alerts.current_condition_details: Subject T-09 (Turia Monarch) has 0 camera trap pings registered over 14 consecutive days. Baseline ping interval: 2.4 days. Injury or natural movement to Maharashtra border under review.
alerts.assessment_notes: Cross-border intelligence team alerted (Mahananda / Mansinghdeo sanctuary check).

alerts.current_condition_details: First recorded biometric match for T-15 (Collarwali Descendant) at newly installed CS-107 Telia Dam telemetry station.
alerts.assessment_notes: Territory map updated. Habitat extension verified around reservoir basin.
